# Functions unreachable from core/cmd/app that are kept on purpose: the public ORM
# API offered to modules (framework surface) and test support (internal/testdb, the
# schema helpers it calls, App.Handler for in-process HTTP tests).
# CI fails when deadcode reports anything NOT listed here — delete the new dead
# code, or add it here if it is deliberate public API. Regenerate with:
#   cd core && deadcode -f '{{range .Funcs}}{{$.Path}}.{{.Name}}{{"\n"}}{{end}}' ./... | sort

# Handler.check validates one write on any orm.Executor. Its caller (the .gan
# importer) lands later in this epic, so nothing reachable from main uses it yet.
core/modules/project.Handler.check
# Exchange layer (WP2/WP3): the neutral Plan model, the .gan adapter and the
# loader. What is still unreachable has its first caller in a later WP of this
# epic: endAfter in the diff (WP3 Task 5), formatByKey and the loader entry
# points loadPlan and planHash in the routes and importer (WP4 Task 8); the
# remaining loader helpers are only reachable through them, which is also why
# workdaysBetween and Weekend.worked stay listed even though planDates (Task 4)
# and the diff (Task 5) call them: deadcode measures reachability from main, so
# a helper used only inside the still-unwired loader subtree stays dead until
# WP4 puts a route on top of it.
